Mode.Name: Hidden folders display
Mode.Hint: "Hide completely" removes the folder and its content from view. "Dim" keeps it visible but faded.

AllTabs.Name: Also in other tabs
AllTabs.Hint: Allows hiding folders in the Actors, Items, Scenes, Tables… tabs, not only Journals. Reloads the page.

Notifications.AllShown: All hidden folders are shown again.

Errors.Save: Could not save hidden folders (see F12 console).
